description: Saves a point (an address or lat/lng in Texas) to the signed-in user's Saved places on the Barrio Grid map, with an optional name and note, so they can find it on the map later and ask about it in any conversation. Use when the user asks to save, bookmark, pin or remember a location ('save this site', 'pin 1201 Main St as the Main Street option'). Only call it when the user asked for it. Returns a map link that opens the place. Free accounts keep 10 saved places, Pro 500. Read them back with my_projects list: saved.

address.description: Texas street address or place. Pass this or lat/lng.

name.description: Short label, e.g. 'Edna 40 acres'. Defaults to the matched address.

note.description: Optional note in the user's words.

name: save_place
title: Save a place to the user's map
